Rekindle.CampingShopDialogue: I'm away on a camping trip. If you have any concerns, please speak to Caroline.
Rekindle.Event.Jorts&Jean: ...Maybe I should talk to Harvey.#$b#I wasn't ready to face it before, but now... I think maybe now I can.
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.0: Jodi and Kent? Dr Harvey is ready
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.1: Jodi, Kent, welcome! How can I help today?$h
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.3: I've been... having trouble adjusting since coming back home.$s#$b#Nightmares, losing focus. Part of me still feels like this isn't real and that I'll wake up tomorrow back in Gotoro.$s#$b#I thought I could manage if I just tried not to think about it, but... it's not working.$5
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.4: I see... Thank you for trusting in me, Kent. It can take a lot of courage to reach out like this.#$b#Do you mind if we go over a few questions? Some of them may be confronting, but we can stop at any time.
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.6: ...Now, as a GP, I can't give you a specific diagnosis on this, but what I can give you is a referral for a psychiatrist in Zuzu City.#$b#She specialises in PTSD and other complex conditions - we've worked together in the past and she's an excellent doctor who I highly recommend.
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.7: Would I need to travel into the city for that?
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.7.DSVKent: Would I need to travel into the city for that?#$b#I already see specialists in Zuzu for my hearing and my leg, so adding another one would make things hard.$s
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.8: For the initial consultation, yes, but afterwards we can arrange a combined treatment plan for telehealth appointments and GP reviews with me.#$b#It's not uncommon for more rural communities like ours.
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.9: That sounds wonderful, Doctor Harvey! Thank you.
Rekindle.Event.Therapy.10: I'm glad to help! Please, feel free to drop in any time, either of you, even if all you need is a friendly ear.$h
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.0: Kent, good to see you! Got a moment?
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.1: Well now, this isn't going to work, isn't it? Let me come around the other side of the fence.$h
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.2: I've been having some trouble lately with managing the town's trash cans.#$b#You might not be aware since it happened while you were away, but because of the recent re-zoning, the council collectors don't come out this far anymore.#$b#So I make my rounds twice a week and take everything to the dump.
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.3: Sounds like a tough job, managing all of that by yourself.
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.4: It is! Which leads into my question.#$b#Jodi mentioned you used to work as a garbage collector back in the city, correct? If you're interested, I could offer you the job.#$b#I'm not getting any younger, after all, and I could do without the added strain on my back.$s#$b#It would only be a part-time position, so the pay wouldn't be high, but it would be consistent work.#$b#You're reliable and have experience, so I think you'd be a good fit. What do you think?
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.5: Hm. That... isn't a bad idea. Two days a week isn't taxing, and I'd appreciate having a specific routine to follow.#$b#It'd be good to be doing something useful as well. Something physical to get me out of my thoughts.
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.5.SaloonBreakfas: Hm. That... isn't a bad idea. Two days a week isn't taxing, and I can balance it with helping Gus at the saloon.#$b#I'd appreciate having a specific routine to follow too and it'd be good to be doing something useful. Something physical to get me out of my thoughts.
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.6: Yeah. Yeah, I'll take you up on that offer. Thanks, Lewis.$h
Rekindle.Event.JobOffer.7: Excellent! My back and I are very appreciative.$h#$b#Follow me, we can get the paperwork sorted and have you ready to go as soon as you like.
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.0: Woo! This is a great song, we'll have to remember it for next week!$h
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.1: It is! The tempo is fast, but still viable for dancing.$h#$b#Ready for the spin?$h
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.3: Want to pause and grab a drink after that, dear?$h
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.6: Hi, Demetrius! Taking a break from dancing?
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.7: It still amazes me how much stamina Robin has. Though it makes sense given her work is much more physically intense than mine.
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.8: Aw, don't sell yourself short! You do a lot of trekking and camping as part of your research, right?#$b#Speaking from experience, that takes more energy than a lot of people think.$h
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.9: Kent! I hadn't seen you there. I've heard from Robin that you and your family have been doing well lately?$h
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.10: They have. Working again has been good for me and therapy has been a lot better than I'd thought.$h#$b#Emily said you go camping a lot?
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.11: I do. As a botanist, it's important for me to see our local environment in its natural state, and the best way to do that is to immerse myself in it.
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.12: Interesting. I used to camp out in the wilderness when I was younger. Take my fishing rod, a tent, some rope, and a knife and live off the land for a few days.$h#$b#I haven't been out like that since--#$b#...$4#$b#Well. Since before.$s
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.13: I'm actually planning to go camping very soon. It's the sporing season for several native fungus species I'm researching at the moment.#$b#If you're interested in joining me, I'd welcome some company, Kent. Maru sometimes comes along, but she's busy with another project right now.
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.14: ...Yeah. Yeah, I think I'd like that. It'd be good to try getting out there again, see if things have changed.$h#$b#Thanks, Demetrius.$h
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.15: Sorry, sorry, I got distracted talking to Gus about his spaghetti recipe.$4#$b#Turns out he-- oh, Kent? Good to see you! You should come around more often so we can catch up, you're always welcome.$h
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.16: In fact, Kent and I were just speaking of going camping together soon!$h
Rekindle.Event.CampingInvite.17: Excellent! Now I won't have to feel guilty about staying home in our nice comfy bed while my husband's out there alone in the wild.$h
Rekindle_CampingTrip.2: Eugh, more steps? I feel like my legs are about to fall off...$s
Rekindle_CampingTrip.3: Come on, Pierre. You live in a two-storey building. You can handle this.$h
Rekindle_CampingTrip.6: Over there, looks like a clearing. Should be a good spot to set up camp.
Rekindle_CampingTrip.7: It would be indeed. That large rock should make for a simple river crossing too.$h
Rekindle_CampingTrip.8: Why did I agree to this...
Rekindle_CampingTrip.9: You can do this, Pierre! All you need to do is place your feet on the flat sections of the rock and avoid any wet patches.
Rekindle_CampingTrip.10: 'All you need to do', he says...$s#$b#Alright, here goes nothing. If I die, tell Abigail and Caroline I love them.
Rekindle_CampingTrip.13: Congratulations on surviving.$h#$b#Let's get these sticks cleared away and set up the tents.
Rekindle_CampingTrip.14: The rest of this event contains a short discussion of PTSD and trauma recovery. Please feel free to skip if it affects you negatively.
Rekindle_CampingTrip.15: Am I correct in assuming you don't enjoy camping, Pierre?
Rekindle_CampingTrip.16: Yes, not in the least! But my family insisted on me joining you both.#$b#'Pierre, you need a break from being in the store all day', Caroline said. 'Dad, you need to touch grass', Abigail said.$s
Rekindle_CampingTrip.18: You both seem to be enjoying yourselves though?
Rekindle_CampingTrip.20: I am. Wasn't sure how it'd go, but it's been good to get back out here like this.$h#$b#After... after everything in Gotoro, I...$s
Rekindle_CampingTrip.21: Don't feel like you have to push yourself to talk about it if you don't want to.$s
Rekindle_CampingTrip.22: Yes, there is no social obligation to tell us anything if you would prefer to keep things private.$s
Rekindle_CampingTrip.23: The concern's appreciated, but I've been going over things with my psych and she's helped me through a lot of it.$h#$b#And it's important for me to talk about how I feel instead of avoiding it.
Rekindle_CampingTrip.26: ...When I first came back, I thought that everything I'd seen over there had changed me for good. That I'd lost everything I used to enjoy.$s#$b#I'd look at things and just... feel nothing, or feel ashamed that I was acting like nothing had happened. I thought maybe it was a punishment for surviving.$5
Rekindle_CampingTrip.28: But part of what we've been working on is reconnecting to the person I was before Gotoro. Being kind to myself, taking things slow.#$b#Accepting I'm not who I was, but that doesn't mean I have to lose my family or the things that were important to me either.#$b#The antidepressants have helped a lot too.$h
Rekindle_CampingTrip.29: It's been a process, and camping in particular has been a hard one to reconnect to. But when you invited me, Demetrius, I figured it was time to push myself a bit.$h
Rekindle_CampingTrip.30: I hadn't known at the time that it would have such importance for you. But I'm glad that you were able to join us on the camping trip.$h
Rekindle_CampingTrip.31: Well. That's probably enough heart-to-heart for one evening. We should get some sleep if we're heading up to the high ridge tomorrow for those mushrooms you're after.$h
Rekindle_CampingTrip.32: A sound idea. Also since you aren't used to camping, Pierre, a word of advice - make sure you keep your shoes inside your tent overnight.#$b#This area is known for toads and you may find yourself with an amphibious friend in the morning otherwise.$h
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.1: Guess what? I just got a call from an old friend inviting me to a cabaret performance tonight at the Chat Rouge!$h#$b#Want to come with me? It's been so long since we've had a girls' day out.$h
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.2: Ooh, we could get tea and pancakes at that fantastic little brunch place, then go to a bathhouse before the show!
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.3: ...but I can't. I've got so much housework to do today and I have to look after Vincent.$s
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.4: Kent can take care of Vincent for the day, I'm sure. And Sam is plenty capable of doing some housework!#$b#Please come, Jodi? It'll be so much more fun going together.#$b#When's the last time either of us took some time just for ourselves, without worrying about the kids or our husbands?$s
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.5: ...you know what, you're right. Let's do it! Let's be spontaneous and forget about the housework for the day.$h
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.7: See Caroline and Jodi's day out? This will not make time progress.
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.10: That was... incredible! I haven't enjoyed myself that much in a long time.#$b#This will probably sound silly, but I feel like I'd forgotten what it's like to do things for me, not for Kent or Sam or Vincent.$s
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.11: It's not silly at all. I know exactly what you mean.$s#$b#That's why I have my sunroom as a place that's all my own. You should join me more often, Jodi - even if you don't feel like gardening, we can chat together.
Rekindle.Event.LadiesDay.12: I really should. I'll have to teach myself that the boys can take some of the load too.$h#$b#And we should definitely make trips like this more often!$h
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.0: Is everything okay, Jodi? It's not often that we see you in the saloon.$3
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.1: It's nothing very important. I just needed to get out of the house for a while.$s
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.2: ...Actually, would you mind if I asked for some advice, Emily?$s
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.3: Of course! I'm always happy to help if I can.
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.4: Caroline and I went on a trip to the city recently and it made me realise that, well... I don't really have any hobbies anymore.$s#$b#I feel like I've become the sort of boring person I never wanted to be, the stay-at-home mother who only talks about housework and her kids.$s#$b#I've become MY mother.$s#$b#I don't want to be that person, but I'm lost on how to start moving away from it. And you always seem so bright and full of energy and you're always talking about your latest projects, so I thought... you might have an idea for me?
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.6: If it's any consolation, I don't think you're a boring person, Jodi! I love chatting with you at aerobics.#$b#It's great that you're thinking about doing things just for you though. It's so easy to lose track of your own desires when you're caring for someone else.#$b#When Haley was younger, I often looked after her when our parents were away and I could feel myself drifting down the same path.$3
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.7: I remember that! Haley was about the same age Vincent is now and you were only a teenager yourself.#$b#It was unfair of your parents to leave so much parenting on your shoulders.$s
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.8: Your casseroles got us through more than a few tough days.$h
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.9: What sort of things did you like when you were younger? That could be a good starting point for rediscovering a hobby again.
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.10: Well... I always did love the idea of travelling the world. Visiting far-off places, trying new foods, seeing exotic animals...$h#$b#That wouldn't work as a hobby though, not while Vincent's still a child.
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.11: Maybe not, but there's always the possibility in the future!$h#$b#Plus you could try things that remind you of travelling, or that would give you ideas for places to visit later.#$b#How about photography or scrapbooking? Reading travel guides? Even something like jigsaw puzzles with pictures of places you want to visit could be fun.$h
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.12: I do like a good jigsaw puzzle! There's something very soothing about seeing the picture come together.$h
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.13: Next, what you need is to dedicate some time each day for YOU - it'll feel selfish at first, but you deserve to be looked after just as much as you look after others.#$b#So unless it's an emergency, this is your time for no housework, no managing others, just doing something fun because it's what you want to do.
Rekindle.Event.HobbiesChat.14: Caroline said the same thing. I suppose it's about time I did what my friends recommended, hm?$h#$b#Thank you, Emily, I appreciate this. I hope your parents are proud of how wise you've grown up to be.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.0: Hi, @! I've just started a new jigsaw puzzle. Want to join me for a while?
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.1: This event may be hard to see on screens smaller than 1920x1080. Zooming out is recommended.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.2: Want to join me for a while?
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.4: I just need a moment first...
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.6: I'll be here when you're ready. Don't take too long though, or I might finish it first!$h
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.7: Adjust your zoom settings, then leave and re-enter Jodi's house to continue.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.8: Oh. Are you busy today? Make sure you're also taking time for relaxing, okay?$s#$b#I'm going to keep working on the puzzle. See you later, @.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.9: Hello again. Is everything sorted now?$h
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.10: I found this one in a plastic bag at the back of the cupboard, so I'm not sure what the picture is.#$b#I wonder when we bought it? It must've been when Sam was little and then the box got lost in moving.$h
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.11: There's a piece sitting in the middle. Where should it go?
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.12: Where should it go? You can try again if you get it wrong.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.21: @, that piece is green. It definitely doesn't go in the sky.$4
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.22: @, that piece has a tree on it. It doesn't go all the way up there.$4
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.23: Hmm... It's close, but I don't think it's a match.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.24: Oh I see, that's where it goes! Well done.$h
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.25: ...I've been doing a lot of jigsaw puzzles recently. It's been nice to take things slow, enjoy a cup of tea and just focus on where the next piece goes.#$b#No need to stress about the dishes or the vacuuming, no need to think about what needs doing for dinner.$s#$b#It's okay to just... breathe.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.26: Look, we're making good progress! Do you recognise the location yet?#$b#The other day, I completed a beautiful thousand-piece puzzle that showed the savannahs of Prairie Island, and there were so many little details in the artwork.#$b#The artist had drawn raccoons hidden everywhere, doing all sorts of silly things. Even one walking on the water!$h
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.27: There's a piece over by itself. Where should it go?
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.28: There's still too much green on that piece for it to go there.$4
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.29: Hmm... It's similar, but the shade of green doesn't match.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.30: @, there's sky on that piece. It doesn't go down near the sand.$4
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.31: Hmm... There's no tree trunk visible on that piece. I think it's close by though.
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.32: @, didn't you see the blue? That piece needs to go higher up.$4
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.33: Nicely done! Another piece in the right place.$h
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.34: ...I often find myself daydreaming about the places from the puzzle images.#$b#It used to be that if I saw a photo like that in a magazine, I'd say to myself 'if only I could visit some day', but now I find myself saying 'some day I'll visit there'.#$b#Next time I go into the city, I'll buy some nice frames for these and put them up as a reminder to myself.$h
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.36: Look at that, @, it's complete! That's the volcano at Ginger Island, isn't it? I can already cross this one off the list of 'places I'll go some day'.$h
Rekindle.Event.JigsawPuzzle.37: Would you like to keep this one, @? It would look nice hanging on your wall.
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.1: Oh. Sorry, I've just had a lot on my mind lately.$s
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.2: We're here if you want to talk about it. It might help to get things out in the open so that you're not struggling alone.
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.3: A trouble shared is a trouble halved
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.4: I suppose you're right. It's... it's about Kent.$s#$b#He's been back home for a while now and therapy has been helping him a lot, but...
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.5: Some days it still feels like there's half the world standing between us.$s#$b#He was always quiet, but now it feels like I've forgotten how to connect with him.$s
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.7: It sounds to me like what you need is to find the spark again.#$b#Find the things that made you fall in love with each other in the first place and remind him of them.$h
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.8: Have you thought of going on another date, Jodi?
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.9: Not with other people - with Kent!#$b#You would've gone on a lot of dates when you first started seeing each other, right? But why does that have to stop just because you're married now?$h
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.10: Yeah, what if you make some time for just the two of you? To help Kent remember that he's here with you, not off in his thoughts.#$b#Demetrius and I said when we got married that we'd always go dancing together on Fridays no matter what, as our 'us' time, and that's what's kept us going strong.$h
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.11: What if you plan something a bit different to usual? Something daring and exciting that'll bring back the thrill when it feels like you're stuck in the same old routine?
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.13: I don't know what you're talking about!
Rekindle.Event.DateIdea.14: Asking my husband out on a date...? It feels a little silly to say.$h#$b#But you're right, it might help. I'll give it a try!
Rekindle.Event.FirstDate.0: (Why are you so nervous about this, Jodi? He's your husband. He loves you.)$s#$b#(What if he thinks it's strange though and it makes things worse?)$s#$b#(No, I won't listen to thoughts like that. He loves you. You can do this, girl.)
Rekindle.Event.FirstDate.2: Kent, I- I've really enjoyed spending time with you lately. And I was wondering if you'd like to go out for a coffee together some time?
Rekindle.Event.FirstDate.3: Jodi? Sounds like you're asking me out on a first date.#$b#Did you forget we're already married?$h
Rekindle.Event.FirstDate.4: How could I ever forget? No, I thought, well... I was thinking it's been a long time since we've done anything just for us without the kids around.#$b#So it would be nice to pretend that we're young again, with no worries or obligations, and just go on a date.$h
Rekindle.Event.FirstDate.5: ...Yeah. I'd love to get coffee with you, Jodi.$h
Rekindle.Event.FirstDate.6: ...It really has been a long time since we've done something like this, hasn't it?
Rekindle.Event.FirstDate.7: Mm. This was nice.$h#$b#Feels like we missed a lot of things in the early days, since we were so busy with everything.
Rekindle.Event.FirstDate.8: I suppose there's no rule saying we can't try again at our age!$h#$b#We could see a movie, go out to a fancy restaurant in the city, take a walk together along the beach...
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.1: The theater's got a special showing of The Zuzu City Express this week. Thought you might like to watch it together and get dinner at the saloon afterwards?$h
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.2: Of course I would, honey! You know how much I love that movie.$h#$b#I'll just tell the boys we'll be out for the evening and give Sam some money for pizza.
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.3: Did you want popcorn, Kent? I remember you had trouble with the noise last time...$s
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.4: I'm okay if I know to expect it. Plus it's pre-made here anyway.#$b#Want to share an extra-large?$h
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.5: Since we're treating ourselves, let's get a stardrop sorbet to split too.$h
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.10: (Remember the first time we saw this?)$h
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.11: (It was at that drive-in theater near Fernmont, wasn't it? How old were we, nineteen?)$h
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.12: (Yeah. You were wearing that green dress with the flowers and you had that pretty necklace your mom gave you.)$h
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.14: (I'll never forget our first official date.)$h
Rekindle.Event.SecondDate.16: (That was the first one where we kissed.)$h
Rekindle.Event.ThirdDate.0: ...It's beautiful, isn't it?#$b#All these years we've lived in Pelican Town, but we've never taken the time to just watch the sunset like this.
Rekindle.Event.ThirdDate.3: You SPLASHED me?! You're so dead, mister!$h
Rekindle.Event.ThirdDate.5: Only if you give me a kiss to say sorry.$h
Rekindle.Event.ThirdDate.7: Let's head back and get dried off. We'll come for a picnic some other time.
Rekindle.Event.ThirdDate.9: Yeah, I am.$h#$b#For a long time there I wasn't, but now...#$b#Yeah. I think I am, or I will be. And a big part of that is thanks to you.$h
Rekindle.Event.ThirdDate.11: I love you, Jodi. Let's go home.$h
Rekindle.Event.FourthDate.1: Hey @, how's it going? I'm taking Vincent to the general store today.$h
Rekindle.Event.FourthDate.2: We're having pizza because Mom and Dad aren't here!$h
Rekindle.Event.FourthDate.3.1: Wow, Vince, way to make it sound like we're doing something bad.$10#$b#
Rekindle.Event.FourthDate.3.2.JodiBirthd: But yeah, Mom and Dad are on a little romantic getaway in the city to celebrate Mom's birthday.$h#$b#
Rekindle.Event.FourthDate.3.2.KentBirthd: But yeah, Mom and Dad are on a little romantic getaway in the city to celebrate Dad's birthday.$h#$b#
Rekindle.Event.FourthDate.3.3: They're only away for a few days and Mom left some prepped food for us in the freezer, but I figured I should take the chance to practise my cooking, y'know?#$b#I gotta step up more and help out at home so that Mom doesn't have to manage everything.$10
Rekindle.Event.FourthDate.5: Yeah, we're gonna pick up some cheese and toppings at the store and I'll teach Vincent how to chop them. Might even try making our own pizza bases too.$h
Rekindle.Event.FourthDate.6: We better get going before Penny gets too annoyed at me for stealing Vincent from class. See you around, @!
Rekindle.ExtraDialogue.Kent.Garbage: ...@? You're making it hard for me to do my job.$s#$b#If you want something from the trash, grab it before I come around.

People might look down on garbage collectors, but they'd start complaining fast if there was no one doing the job.
You can keep anything interesting you find in the trash. Means there's less for me to carry.$h
...People in this town throw out the strangest things some days.$s
The trash around Pelican Town is nothing compared to what we used to process back in Zuzu.
Phew, finished up. I'll toss the trash bags in the back of Lewis's truck for now and he'll sort out taking it to the dump later.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Hangout.1: It's always peaceful up here by the lake.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Hangout.2: I don't know a lot of the more scientific stuff Demetrius talks about, but it's good listening to him regardless.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Hangout.3: Should bring my rod one of these days. It'd be good to cast a line and see what bites.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Hangout.4: It'll be too cold to be out here come winter. Got to enjoy it while we can.
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Hangout.5: We'll be going camping again soon. Demetrius wants to see if he can learn more about the mountain plants.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Date.Foun: I remember. You picked a white rose for me and and I kept it until the petals fell off.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Date.Beac: It might've been. Not as pretty as you though, love.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Date.Moun: If you get cold, Jodi, I'll wrap my arms around you and keep you warm.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Kent.Date.Fore: The sound of the water is soothing...
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Sunroom.1: Your flowers have been doing so well lately! This one in particular is beautiful.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Sunroom.2: Of course, here they are. I'll help trim back some of the damaged leaves too.
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Sunroom.3: I've been meaning to do something nice with our little garden, but it's a lot of effort.$s
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Sunroom.4: They really are. Are they nearly ready for harvest?
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Sunroom.5: How about this one over here? The soil's looking a bit dry.
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Puzzle.1: Hmm... Does this piece go here or over there...?
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Puzzle.2: Do these colours match? No, this one's more sandy while that one's more tan...
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Puzzle.3: This piece has such an odd shape to it. What do you match up with?
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Puzzle.4: Another edge piece! I know just where this one goes.$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Puzzle.5: Aha, I remember seeing a piece that connected with this one! It was just over there.
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Date.Foun: Remember when we first moved here? There used to be that little rose garden beside the community centre.
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Date.Beac: Look, there was a splash out there! Do you think it was a mermaid?$h
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Date.Moun: Brr, the mountain breeze is a little crisp!
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Jodi.Date.Fore: It is, isn't it? We should come out this way more often.
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Demetrius.Hang: It is. I often come out here when I feel overstimulated by my work or by misunderstandings with my research colleagues.
I've been telling Kent about the birdlife we get around the lake.#$b#Did you know that Stardew Valley is one of the few nesting places for the pink-crowned whimbrel, @? Remarkable bird.$h
While the valley doesn't have strict fishing regulations, it is still best to throw back any fish of a particularly small size to ensure a stable breeding stock for the next year.
You're always welcome to visit me in the lab during the winter if the walk up here isn't too precarious, Kent.
Yes, there's one we've recently discovered which has ingenious reflective hairs on its leaves!$h#$b#I'm excited to observe whether this attracts or repels potential grazers.
Rekindle.LocationDialogue.Caroline.Sunro: I've been trying a new fertilizer blend and the plants have really responded well to it.$h
I've been meaning to prune this one back a bit. Could you pass me the secateurs please?
I can give you recommendations for some hardy plants that don't need a lot of care if you like?
Mm, the leaves on this one are so fragrant.$h
Yes, a little more water for that one, I think. Thank you, Jodi.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_Therapy.Jod: I'm so relieved that Kent finally felt ready to speak with Doctor Harvey... I wish there was more I could do to support him myself.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Jo: Financially we've been doing alright with the money from Kent's pension, but the extra money will be helpful. More importantly, it's been good for him to have something where he feels like he's helping.#$b#He's always preferred having a structure and routine to follow, so being at home with nothing to do was a struggle for him.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingInvi: We went camping as a family a few times when the boys were younger, but I never enjoyed it much. It was too stressful for me.$s#$b#But I'm glad that Kent can enjoy camping with a friend like Demetrius now.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingTrip: Kent and Demetrius are already talking about going camping again together some time soon.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DadsAway.Jo: I'm sure Kent will be alright, but I still worry about him. What if he has a panic attack while he's away?$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DateIdea.Jo: It's a good idea, although... I keep overthinking things and second-guessing myself.$s#$b#@, if your spouse asked you out on a date, would you think that was odd?
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.J: Ooh, I'm getting all giddy thinking about what sort of things Kent and I could do for our next date. It's like being a schoolgirl again.$h
%Jodi seems to be lost in thought with a dreamy smile on her face.#$b#@? Sorry, I didn't see you there! I was just thinking about old memories.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_ThirdDate.J: The sunset on the water really is beautiful, isn't it...?#$b#Sometimes it's important to not worry about the past or the future and just enjoy the present moment.
@! How have things been back home? Did anything happen with Sam or Vincent?#$b#Oh, our trip? We booked a fancy restaurant for the birthday dinner and then went to see a musical at the Regal. I even managed to not stress too much about the boys!$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_LadiesDay.J: I hadn't realised how much I needed a day to just relax like that.#$b#There's a bathhouse a little past Robin's place, isn't there? I should visit it sometime.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_HobbiesChat: @, you wouldn't happen to know if JojaMart sells jigsaw puzzles, would you...?
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JigsawPuzzl: I was a little surprised at myself for how much I'd been enjoying doing jigsaw puzzles.$h#$b#But I've been thinking it over and it's not just the puzzle itself, it's that it lets me organise things without there being anything at stake if I can't finish.#$b#...perhaps I should talk to Kent's therapist myself sometime.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_Therapy.Ken: ...$5#$b#It doesn't feel real somehow. Like I'm still waiting for someone to laugh and tell me that this whole thing is just a prank.#$b#I hope it's not though. By all that's good, I hope that it's real and things can change for me.$5
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ke: It'll take some time to get used to working like this again. But I'm looking forward to it.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingInvi: It's been a long time since I last went camping. Wonder if I'll still remember everything?
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingTrip: I realised the other day that I feel... light. Lighter than I have in a long time.$h#$b#Hadn't realised how much of a weight I'd been carrying or that it'd slowly stopped being so much.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DateIdea.Ke: @, has Jodi told you anything about planning something...? No? Hm.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.K: Heh. Can't say I was expecting that, but Jodi always did take the lead for things like this.$h
I'm glad I managed to catch Jodi just in time for the movie.$h#$b#Would've been awkward if I'd had to find her at the store.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_ThirdDate.K: It's all too rare these days that we get to just act like kids and enjoy the moment.
It was good to get away for a few days and spend time with Jodi.$h#$b#She stressed about things for a while, but that's just how she is. And at least it wasn't the whole time.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_LadiesDay.K: Jodi called the home phone a while back saying that she'd gone out with Caroline and wouldn't be back 'til late.#$b#Not like her to head off on a whim like that, but it sounds like she enjoyed herself.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_HobbiesChat: Something's really been eating at Jodi recently and we haven't found time to talk about it.#$b#She does so much to keep our family together. And there's still too many days where I want to help but can't.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JigsawPuzzl: It's good to see Jodi enjoying herself and taking time to relax.$h#$b#Some day when Vincent is older, we'll go travelling together like she deserves.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_Therapy.Sam: Dad's gonna start seeing a therapist in Zuzu to help him out with his PTSD.#$b#...I'm glad, @. I'm really, really glad. I didn't want to admit it, but I was really scared that my dad might've never been able to get better.$7
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Sa: It's funny, things have kinda come full circle.$h#$b#See, Dad being a garbage man is how he and Mom met. He was one of the garbage truck drivers for her suburb, and she was sweet on him so she used to always bring the trash out herself and say hi.#$b#Then they had me, Dad switched careers, they moved out here, and everything else happened. But that's how it started.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingInvi: Sounds pretty chill, don't you think, going camping up in the mountains and cooking your dinner over a campfire? As long as I could take my boombox with me anyway.$h#$b#Dad's excited for it and from what Seb's told me, so's Demetrius.#$b#And Seb's pretty happy that Demetrius will be out of the house for a while too.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DadsAway.Sa: Nah, I'm not stressed about my old man. He used to take me camping when I was a kid and he showed me all these, like, survival guy tricks he knows.#$b#I don't remember any of them, but I know he does even though it's been years since then.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DateIdea.Sa: Mom came back from aerobics club acting weird. She was kinda shifty, but also seemed happy...? Any idea what that's about, @?$7
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.S: Okay, something's definitely going on and I don't know what. I saw my parents sneaking off to the saloon in the middle of the day, and Mom never goes to the saloon.$7
...Oh. Hey @, remember when I said something was going on that time when I saw my parents sneaking off to the saloon?#$b#Turns out they were on a date. They went on another one to the movies.$10
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_ThirdDate.S: It's been really sweet seeing my parents so happy together. Feels like it's been a long time since I've seen my mom smile this much.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JodiKentAwa: Don't worry, @, I got this. I've got a schedule written up for meal times, when Vincent gets picked up for class, and homework times so I don't forget.$h#$b#And I've got Emily and Caroline on speed-dial if anything goes wrong.
Phew, I'm glad my parents are back. I never realised how hard it must've been for Mom looking after me and Vince without Dad around until now.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_LadiesDay.S: I haven't seen Mom this happy in a long time. Sounds like she had a great day out with Caroline.$h#$b#...I really gotta step up more and help out around the house so that she can have days like that more often, huh?$10
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_HobbiesChat: Emily said that she and Mom had a heart-to-heart about some important stuff. I hope everything's okay.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JigsawPuzzl: When Mom's having puzzle time, be careful you don't interrupt her. Last time I did, she kicked me out of the house for an hour.$10
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_Therapy.Vin: Farmer @, Doctor Harvey said that Dad's gonna start talking to a doctor that helps people when their brains make bad feelings.#$b#Do you think it'll help him be more happy again?$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Vi: Did you know that Dad used to be a garbage man before too? Sam told me!#$b#That was before I was born though, so I don't remember it.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingInvi: Dad said he's going camping soon with Mr Demetrius!$h#$b#We went camping a lot when I was really little, but I remember one time the tent was really leaky and it dripped on my head, so it wasn't very fun.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingTrip: Dad's back! He said they had to jump across this huuuuuuge rock and Mr Pierre nearly fell in the river!$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DadsAway.Vi: I hope Dad and Mr Demetrius and Mr Pierre don't get lost in the woods and have to eat bugs for their dinner.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DateIdea.Vi: Farmer @, what's a date? I heard Mom say that, but I don't get it.$3
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.V: Dad must be in a really good mood because he's gonna try cooking dinner tonight.$h
Aw, I wanted to go watch a movie at the theater with Mom and Dad.$s#$b#But we got pizza for dinner while they were out, so I guess that's okay.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_ThirdDate.V: Mom and Dad came back all wet! If I came back home like that, they would've gotten so mad at me. It's not fair.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JodiKentAwa: Pizza! Pizza! Pizza! Sam's pizza is so yummy!$h#$b#When Mom and Dad get back, we should all make pizza together!$h
Mom and Dad are back! And they bought me a present too!$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_LadiesDay.V: I'm gonna be a big boy and help Mom with the laundry when she's tired!#$b#It's like a game, making sure only the dark stuff goes here and only the light stuff goes there.#$b#...what about my black and white cow socks? Where do they go?$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_HobbiesChat: After she came back from the saloon, Mom seemed kinda sad when she looked at me.#$b#Did... did I do something wrong, Farmer @?$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JigsawPuzzl: Mom's been letting me help with her puzzles even though they're a lot harder than mine.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_Therapy.Car: I'm so glad to hear that Kent was able to get a referral. Not knowing how to help him has been such a strain on Jodi since his return.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ca: Garbage collector might not be the most glamorous of jobs, but I'm sure Kent will do well. And only having two days a week will help him adjust too.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingInvi: Pierre seemed oddly down for a moment when I told him the news about Kent and Demetrius planning a camping trip together. Do you think he felt a bit left out?$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingTrip: Well, I don't know if you could consider it a success that Abigail and I convinced Pierre to go camping, after everything he went through.#$b#But he said he doesn't regret going, so I think he must have enjoyed it at least a little.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DadsAway.Ca: Feel free to take anything you need from the store while Pierre's away and just leave the money on the counter. We trust you.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DateIdea.Ca: I hope things work out for Jodi.$s#$b#Pierre and I have our moments of conflict like any couple does, but we've also had all these etxra years together to learn how we reconnect afterwards, which Jodi and Kent missed out on while he was over in Gotoro.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.C: Ooh, it sounds like everything went well from what Jodi was telling me!#$b#Oh? Well, if you don't know, @, then it's not for me to tell you. You'll have to ask Jodi herself.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JodiKentAwa: It's so nice that Kent and Jodi are finally taking some time for themselves like this!#$b#I'll have to convince Pierre to close up shop sometime so we can do the same.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_LadiesDay.C: I'm going to be humming that song for days. What a catchy tune!$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_HobbiesChat: Emily's quite wise for her age, you know. Under all that bubbliness and whimsy of hers, there's a soul that deeply cares about others and knows when to reach out with help.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JigsawPuzzl: Jodi brought a jigsaw puzzle over to the sunroom the other day! We chatted together while I did my gardening and she mulled over the pieces.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_Therapy.Har: Hm? Kent's appointment? @, you know I can't give you details under doctor-patient confidentiality.$a#$b#What I will say though is that I was very glad to see him reach out about his mental health. It's not an easy thing to do.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ha: I'm glad to see that Kent's new job has been a good fit for him. Having a regular routine and fulfilling work, whether paid or volunteer, can be very helpful in maintaing our mental health.$h
The Zuzu City Express is a classic film. I must have seen it dozens of times, but I still get so engrossed in it that I don't notice anything else around me.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_Therapy.Lew: It's good to see some of the life returning to Kent's expression. It must be a big relief to Jodi and their sons as well.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Le: I tell you what, @, I've certainly been sleeping easier since Kent agreed to take on the garbage collection!$h#$b#He's hard-working and trustworthy, so I know he'll do a good job. And now I have more time to hopefully get on top of the never-ending paperwork.#$b#It's ridiculous of course that the Governor couldn't put in an exception for us so that we're covered under council regulations as all of our neighbours are, but what can you do when it comes to red tape like that?$s#$b#
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Gu: I'll have a quiet word with Kent later and let him know about my little arrangement with the trash cans for Linus. I'm sure he'll understand.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.G: Ah, it's good to see Jodi and Kent smiling at each other like that again.#$b#And they have good taste to come buy my coffee on their date!$h
Hmph. Young people who'd rather whisper sweet nothings to each other than actually watch a film...#$b#Take your romantic nonsense elsewhere! Some of us are trying to concentrate!$a

Don't mind George. Back when we were young, he used to do the exact same thing!$h#$b#Oh, we snuck into the back seats of the cinema many a time. And we'd have to stay especially quiet since the films were silent in those days.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Pi: Kent will be managing the town's garbage from now on, huh? It's not a job I'd want to do, but a lot of people would say the same about running a shop.#$b#The general store actually has surprisingly little garbage to dispose of. Any food products that can't be sold go into Caroline's compost bins.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingTrip: Hmph. Have you been talking to Abigail, @?$a#$b#No, I did not 'nearly fall in'. I leapt across the rock like an antelope. Maybe a somewhat wobbly-legged antelope, but still.#$b#...I might be open to going again, if Kent and Demetrius plan another trip.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_LadiesDay.P: I admit I'm a bit jealous of Caroline and Jodi being able to just go into the city like that.$s#$b#If I were to suddenly close down the shop without notice, I'd get complaints from my customers.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JigsawPuzzl: Jodi's been asking me recently if I sell any jigsaw puzzles!$4#$b#It's an odd request, but I aim to please when it comes to my customers, so I put in a special order for her.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.De: @, did you know that decomposers like saprotrophic fungi and detritivorous arthropods are the garbage collectors of the natural world? Without their efforts, we would be overrun by waste matter.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingInvi: Sometimes I prefer being alone when doing research so that I'm better able to focus, but Kent is a good friend who understands the way I work.#$b#I think this camping trip will be an enjoyable and productive one.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingTrip: It truly is fortunate that here in the valley, we have easy access to a variety of microhabits which carry essential data for my research.$h#$b#I'd like to perform a biodiversity survey in the future and properly catalogue what species call this area home.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ab: Sam mentioned that his dad is working as a garbage collector again. I think he's mostly just glad that his dad won't be leaving town anytime soon.#$b#Which is fair. I might have issues with my dad sometimes, but I wouldn't want him to go through any of the stuff Sam's dad has.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingInvi: Sam and Sebastian said that Sam's dad and Demetrius are gonna be away for a few days on a camping trip soon.#$b#...I wonder if... Hm. Ideas.$3
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DadsAway.Ab: Ha, it worked perfectly! What I'd give to see Dad's face right now.$h#$b#Mom and I convinced him to join Demetrius and Sam's dad on this camping trip and I bet Dad's fallen in the mud at least once.#$b#Maybe now he'll realise that adventuring isn't that bad!
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingTrip: @, did you hear? Dad nearly fell in when crossing this mountain river, and then he forgot about the mosquito screen in his tent and got bitten like crazy.$h#$b#And I think maybe he put his hand in a nettle bush or something too, it was all swollen up. If he'd asked ME, I could've warned him about all of that stuff.#$b#But I think he had a good time anyway. He doesn't want to admit it, but he smiles a bit when he's complaining about it.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ro: There's nothing wrong with a man being a househusband while his wife works, in my opinion, but Kent seems happier now that he has his part-time work.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingInvi: It's not often that Demetrius meets someone who's both outdoorsy and willing to listen the way Kent does when Demetrius starts talking about his interests.$h#$b#This camping trip will be good for both of them, I think.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DadsAway.Ro: While Demetrius is away, this is my chance to eat all the cilantro I want!$h#$b#I love the stuff, but he's unfortunately afflicted with the soap-taste gene so he doesn't use it much when he's cooking.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_CampingTrip: I don't mind going camping with Demetrius every now and then, but the older I get, the less I want to sleep with only a thin layer of padding between me and the rocks.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.R: As you get older, it's important to remember that relationships aren't automatic - they only flourish if you're willing to put time into them.#$b#A lot of married couples forget that and then things fall apart.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JodiKentAwa: A romantic birthday getaway, huh? I'll have to keep that in mind for Demetrius's next birthday.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ma: If Kent decides he'd like more work than what Lewis is offering, I'll let Jodi know that I'm willing to pay for some help in mucking out the animal pens.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DateIdea.Ma: I do hope that things work out well for Kent and Jodi. It takes a lot of love to carry a relationship through that much time away from each other.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.M: Perhaps I can encourage a certain someone to take a leaf out of Jodi's book...
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JodiKentAwa: Sam's doing a fine job of looking after his little brother while Jodi and Kent are away. He and Vincent have been coming around to play with Jas after their classes have finished.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Em: It's great to see Kent around town more often! I'm making sure I say hello to him when he comes by during his garbage collection and when he comes to the saloon.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_DateIdea.Em: Jodi and Kent have a stronger connection than I think they realise. I'm positive that things will turn out well for them.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_FirstDate.E: Have you seen Jodi today? There's so much pink in her aura that I can tell immediately things went well with the date.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JodiKentAwa: I told Jodi that I'd help look after Vincent while she and Kent were away if she wanted, but she said she has faith in Sam that he'll do a good job.#$b#I have faith in him too, but it's always good to have support, so I told Sam the same thing in case he needs help.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Al: I dunno how I feel about Sam's dad going through our garbage, even if it's his job.$s#$b#What? I don't think he's going to do anything, but it just feels kind of weird. Like, that's someone I know. I don't want him seeing everything I throw out.$7
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ge: He's a good man, Kent. Works hard and looks after his family.#$b#Being a garbage man is a respectable job too. Keeps the raccoons out and much better than getting involved in other people's business overseas.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ev: I had a little chat with Kent the other day when he was collecting our bins. He's been through so much, the poor man.$s
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ja: Vincent said his dad got a new job taking all the trash from all the trash cans around town! It must smell pretty bad, but I bet it doesn't smell as bad as the sewers.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Sh: Huh, Kent's doing the garbage rounds now? Good luck to him if he's clearing out the saloon bins after a Friday night.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Ha: Ew, Sam's dad was standing next to our trash can the other day and I don't even want to know what he was doing.$3#$b#...oh, he got a new job emptying all the trash cans? I guess that's okay then even if it's still kind of gross.#$b#Maybe I'll ask Sam if his dad wants some of my dad's unopened cologne bottles.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Se: Sam's been talking a lot about how his dad got a new job. Good for him.#$b#We still have to take our trash into town ourselves though since we're all the way up here.
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Pe: It's nice to see Vincent's father looking brighter these days! He smiles a lot more when I tell him about how Vincent has been doing in class.$h
Rekindle.CTDialogue.Rekindle_JobOffer.Pa: I got a lot of respect for garbage collectors, you know. One of those jobs like truck-driving that doesn't get enough appreciation from people.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.Mon6: I'd be lying if I said I never miss the freedom of being young... but I think I'm starting to get some of that freedom back.#$b#You have to fight for it as an adult, I'm learning.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.Wed4: I started wearing rubber gloves to keep my hands soft while doing housework. The older you get, the more work you have to do to stay healthy.#$b#But I'm trying to make sure I also take time for myself away from housework. I'm getting outside more often.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.Sun8: I had a dream that I had complete freedom, no obligation to anyone but myself...#$b#Ahh, it was a nice dream. Reality isn't so bad though. Sam's taking care of the cleaning today, so I can relax and enjoy the day.$h
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.summer_Mon: Summer is nice, isn't it? I might go for a walk down to the river later.#$b#The garden and the house can take care of themselves for a change.$h
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.summer_Thu: Housework is frustrating because you're never finished. The day after I sweep the floor, it's dirty again.#$b#I'm getting better about not letting that bother me though. We'll survive if the floor is dirty for a few days.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.fall_Thu: Maybe I've spoiled the boys a bit. They've never had to do any chores.#$e#I guess I want them to be able to enjoy their childhood while they still can. Well, Sam's basically a man now, though.#$b#He's starting to help out more often though, even without me asking him. It's a positive sign.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.fall_Sun2: When you become a parent, you have to leave your old lifestyle behind.#$b#But maybe that's true of any major life event. And I'm learning that some things don't have to be left behind forever.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.winter_Tue6: Sometimes I dream about how life might be on my own... without a family to look after.#$b#I think everyone dreams about how things might be if they were different though.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.winter_Wed2: What do I do for fun? I like doing jigsaw puzzles. You should try them sometime!
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.winter_Thu8: We kind of rushed into our marriage because we were young and thought we were running out of time...#$b#But it's not too late. We can still do the things we wanted to do back then and never had time for.#$b#And who knows, maybe it'll be better now with the advantage of maturity than it would've been back then.$h
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.winter_Fri: It would be nice to take a vacation soon. I might see if Kent has any ideas on where he'd like to go.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.winter_Wed4_: Kent has been home for a while now. It's been a slow process for him, but I think he's starting to improve.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_spr: I used to think that I had to keep the house spotless because everyone who came by would notice and judge me for it.#$b#But I'm trying to let things like that go. I have a loving family and good friends who don't mind if there's a little dirt from time to time.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_sum: There are so many big milestones when you're younger. Getting married, having kids, moving into a house... what comes after that?#$b#We'll just have to make our own milestones.$h
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_win: What do I do for fun? I like doing jigsaw puzzles. You should try them sometime!
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_Mon: I'd be lying if I said I never long for the freedom of youth... But I have more freedom for myself nowadays than I used to.#$b#And once Vincent is old enough to spread his wings, Kent and I will be able to decide if we still want to go travelling like we wanted to when we were young.
I had enough time to take a nap the other day. I'd almost forgotten what it's like.$h
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_Tue: Vincent made his bed this morning without being asked! He's getting better at taking initiative with things like that.#$e#Then he tried asking for candy as payment for his 'work'. Where did he learn a thing like that?$h
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_Wed: When I was younger, I had so many dreams. I wanted to travel the world, to learn to ride a horse, to be...#$b#Gosh, it seems silly now, but I wanted to be a singer, at one point.$h#$b#I can live vicariously through Sam on that one though, and I still have time to achieve the others.$h

I used to feel like I'd lost my identity to being a wife and mother. I'd forgotten what dreams I had when I was young.$s#$b#But now I'm starting to make space for me again. I'm rediscovering who 'Jodi' the woman is, not 'Jodi' the mother' or 'Jodi' the wife.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_Thu: If you ever have any leftovers that you can't eat, I'd happily take them off your hands.#$e#Sam's cooking is improving, but we could all do with a day of no cooking from time to time.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_Sun: I had a dream that I had complete freedom, no obligation to anyone but myself...#$b#Ahh, it was a nice dream. Reality isn't so bad though. Sam's taking care of the cleaning today, so I can relax and enjoy the day.$h
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_sum: It was such a relief to see Kent come home. I just never expected to see how much he had changed.$s#$b#I'm glad though that he's pushing himself to open up more. I want to be there beside him through his recovery, but he's the only one who can take those steps.
Kent truly is a good man at heart. I hope you'll see that again in time.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_fal: I wonder if things will ever go back to the way they were with Kent?$s#$b#Perhaps that's unfair of me to ask. Anyone would change after what he went through, but he's trying his best and he's making progress.

Oh! Sorry, can you repeat that? I'm so tired today, it's like my brain is underwater.#$b#Kent didn't sleep much at all last night. Naturally, neither did I.$s#$e#It's not an easy process for him, but I have to remind myself that for every bad day, there's been good days too. Some day the good days will outnumber the bad.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_win: When you make a commitment to marry someone, a lot of people don't realize something important...#$b#...that you're marrying not only that person today, but every person they will eventually become, too.#$e#Kent has changed. It's not always easy to accept that. But he's still the man I married even despite that change.#$b#I don't know the full extent of what he went through and I don't think I ever will, but that doesn't change the commitment I made.#$e#Well, marriage isn't about making your life any easier. It's about loving and being loved, because we can, because it's how we were created.#$e#Anyway, sorry for rambling at you! Please don't let me keep you from your day.

Oh, what did you say? I'm sorry, I'm just so tired today!#$b#Kent was tossing and turning all night. He must have been having bad dreams again.$s#$e#I'm glad that he has another appointment with his psychiatrist scheduled soon. Hopefully she can help him with the dreams.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_Thu: Kent was smiling all of this morning and offered to take care of the housework for me.$h#$e#It's easy to take little things like that for granted when you're used to having them, but it's important to be thankful for them.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Jodi.CFE_Jodi_Fri: Kent made it through to the end of our movie night! He wanted to push himself by watching an action movie, and even though I could see it was tough at points, he still made it.#$b#I'm proud of him.$h
We were watching a movie last night, but halfway through, Kent had to leave the room.$s#$b#I went after him and he was so upset with himself that he'd been affected to that level.$s
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.Mon4: I think I'm getting used to being back home now. I don't feel like I need to watch every shadow anymore.#$b#Therapy has been helping a lot with that, and Jodi and Sam have been supporting me as much as they can. I have a lot to appreciate.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.Thu6: I've been up since 4 o'clock... sometimes I wonder if I'll ever get back into a normal routine.#$e#Sam has really grown up since I left. He's an adult now.#$b#I wish I could've been there for him earlier, but I can do my best to be here for him and for Vincent now.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.Sat8: I have trouble sleeping sometimes, so please excuse me if I seem tired.#$b#It's been improving recently though and there's more good days in between. Maybe one day these bad dreams will feel like just a bad dream themselves.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.Wed6: ...I lost a lot of friends in the destruction. What's sad is that I can't even remember their faces.#$b#My psychiatrist said that that's a common thing with cases like mine though. Trauma affects the memory.#$e#When I'm ready, I'll reach out to their families and ask if they could share any photos with me.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_sum: @, I know you want to help me, and I appreciate it. Some things will never be the same again, but that doesn't mean they're broken forever.#$b#It's miles away from perfect, but each day I'm still trying to do my best, for the kids, for Jodi...#$b#...and then I'll pray it's enough.

I worry sometimes about losing my temper with Vince if he's not listening to me. In those cases, I just leave the room and count until I'm feeling grounded again.#$e#Jodi used to get upset, saying that I was leaving all the parenting to her, but we talked it over together and then explained to Vince too.#$b#If the same techniques can help him to manage his anger, that's a good thing.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_fal: How am I doing? If you'd asked me that not too long ago, I would've answered with "flat".#$b#I still have days where I just can't bring myself to feel anything, or whatever emotions I have feel like they're muffled. But my medication is helping with that.
Yesterday's accomplishment was that I went for a walk.#$b#It might not seem like much of an achievement, but it was a bad day for me. So I'm celebrating the little wins as well.

Sometimes, I can feel anger welling up within me, but I'm getting better at catching it and grounding myself before it's too late.#$e#I don't ever want to lose my temper in front of my family, especially Vincent.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_win: Sometimes I have this dream where I'm on the front lines again, but Sam's there trying to draw the soldiers away from us.$s#$b#Then for some reason, Vincent shows up.$s#$e#It all feels so real in the dream, but Jodi being there when I wake up helps me reconnect with the real world.

Despite all the evils of the world, we've all got to be good to each other and enjoy the good times.#$e#It's not easy and sometimes it feels selfish after everything I've seen.#$b#But it's important. It's how I was raised and it's how I want my sons to see the world.

I'd been in the middle of a bad dream when Vincent woke me up. I accidentally scared him, poor kid.$s#$b#He tried to make me feel better by making me breakfast in bed. Some days I wonder what I did to deserve a family that loves me despite everything.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_Mon: I used to assign a deep meaning to the things I cared about: loving my family, contributing to society...#$b#Part of what I've been talking to my psych about is reconnecting to that. Letting those values be the things that bring me back to myself.
So, what are you looking forward to this week?#$b#I'm looking forward to going for a walk, maybe even chatting with someone. It's important to enjoy the small things.$h

I think I'm getting used to being back home now. I don't feel like I need to watch every shadow anymore.#$b#Therapy has been helping a lot with that, and Jodi and Sam have been supporting me as much as they can. I have a lot to appreciate.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_Wed: Sometimes I catch myself wondering if Jodi and the boys are any better off with me here.$s#$b#Jodi admonishes me for doubting though and tells me that they all still love me no matter what.#$e#It feels more real now when she says it than it used to.$h

...I lost a lot of friends in the destruction. What's sad is that I can't even remember their faces.#$b#My psychiatrist said that that's a common thing with cases like mine though. Trauma affects the memory.#$e#When I'm ready, I'll reach out to their families and ask if they could share any photos with me.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_Thu: I had a good time playing with Vince yesterday.$h#$b#I couldn't keep up my energy the whole time, but he still had fun and he understood when I needed to stop.

I talked to one of my contacts on the phone. He said watching cartoons with his daughter helped 'bring the color back.'#$e#I think I get what he means by that now. Going for walks with Jodi, talking with Sam, and playing with Vince are the bright spots of my day.

I've been up since 4 o'clock... sometimes I wonder if I'll ever get back into a normal routine.#$e#Sam has really grown up since I left. He's an adult now.#$b#I wish I could've been there for him earlier, but I can do my best to be here for him and for Vincent now.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_Fri: In the war, so many people are forced to learn that survival is the only right... the only good.#$b#It's hard to resume a normal life again after that, especially without professional help.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_Sat: I wish I had more ideas for how to do something special for Jodi. She's really given a lot for Sam and Vincent.#$e#When I was younger, I did elaborate gestures all the time. ...I think. It's tough to remember them now.$s#$b#But she'd tell you that the small gestures are just as important. I'll try to take on more of the household chores so she can relax.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Kent.CFE_Kent_Sun: I know I'm not the most fun person to talk to, @, but you keep coming around.#$b#Thank you for being such a kind friend.$h#$e#I've seen some horrible things. Talking about it doesn't change anything that happened, but it's helped me to process things and to find some normality again.

What gets you through the day, @? I used to feel like no matter how hard I tried, I just couldn't bring myself to care about anything.#$b#I've been focusing on the little things though. The warmth of a cup of coffee. The breeze when I go for a walk. Eating something good. Surprisingly, it helps.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Vincent.Mon4: $d kent#I'm glad Dad's back. He's different from what I remember, but Mom said that's because his brain got hurt.#$b#He has a special doctor to help him and when he's feeling better, he'll play with me again.|Dad's not around much... I miss playing with him.$s
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Vincent.Sat8: $d kent#Dad gets tired a lot when he plays with me, but that's okay. It's better than not playing with him at all.|I wonder if Dad will ever come home...$s
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Sam.Thu6_2.PreThe: ...I have mixed feelings about my father being back. Sometimes I don't know how to act around him.$s#$b#I want to help him with things, but he doesn't open up to us.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Sam.Thu6_2.PostTh: ...I'm glad my father is back, but sometimes it's hard to know what to say.$s#$b#Things are getting better since he started getting therapy though. He sounds more like he used to.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Sam.summer_Thu6_2: Sometimes I can hear my dad pacing down the hallway at night.$s#$b#I think he appreciates it if I come out and talk to him though. It distracts him from whatever's going through his mind.
Rekindle.DailyDialogue.Sam.Sun8: I used to wonder if my mother was actually happy with her life... But it seems like things have improved now.#$b#I've been making an effort to help out more with the housework so that she doesn't have to do everything.
CFE_Sam_summerTue10: Maybe I should learn how to cook more kinds of food.#$b#You wouldn't mind being my taste tester, right?$h
CFE_Sam_fallTue8: I did some cleaning up around the house to make things easier for my mom and she was pretty thankful.#$b#Sounds like it wasn't the biggest source of her stress, but it still makes a difference. And she's been happier since getting into new hobbies.
CFE_Sam_fallWed6: I think I'm becoming a pizza purist. Toppings are nice, but if you get just the right blend of cheeses, that's all you really need.#$e#I gotta practise more so I can perfect my pizza skills.$h
CFE_Sam_winterSun6: Try not to make a mess in the house. My mom doesn't like it when things aren't kept clean.#$e#It, uh... used to actually a legit struggle sometimes.$s#$b#But I think it might've been, like, a symptom of something else. She's more relaxed about it now.
CFE_Sam_Sun8: I used to wonder if my mother was actually happy with her life... But it seems like things have improved now.#$b#I've been making an effort to help out more with the housework so that she doesn't have to do everything.
CFE_Sam_summerThu6y2: Sometimes I can hear my dad pacing down the hallway at night.$s#$b#I think he appreciates it if I come out and talk to him though. It distracts him from whatever's going through his mind.
CFE_Sam_fallMon10y2: I told my dad, "Look, Dad, you can trust me with what's on your mind. I'm not a kid anymore."#$b#I don't think he'll ever give up wanting to protect me, but we actually had a good talk about how he was feeling and how therapy's been going.#$b#It feels good to know he trusts me with that.$h
CFE_Sam_fallMon6y2: My dad? Sometimes it's easier just to give him space, but he does want to connect with me. I think he's just forgotten how.
CFE_Sam_Tue4y2: I tried fixing a bowl of cereal for my dad, but he couldn't eat it. He was having a bad brain day, I guess.$s
CFE_Sam_Thu8y2: Hey, if you get to talking with my dad, just uh... show him some support, if it's not too much to ask.#$e#He's doing his best, but he went through some pretty heavy stuff. It'll take time before he's back to normal.
CFE_Sam_Thu4y2: ...I'm glad my father is back, but sometimes it's hard to know what to say.$s#$b#Things are getting better since he started getting therapy though. He sounds more like he used to.
CFE_Sam_Sat8y2: Having my dad back has been... even more different than I expected. Sometimes I just don't know I'm supposed to act around him.$s#$b#I don't think he knows how to treat me either. Like, am I a kid again or am I an adult?$s
